environment.other_environment_inputs: GitHub Issues API credential for append-only queue snapshots supplied by the parent scheduler to re-read live task/resource lease state before each write; no GitHub API write capability is used by the assessor.

task_input.note: The scheduler validates the predecessor proof. workflow_run_id plus artifact_sha256 deterministically selects the same bounded URL batch on every retry. Each completed URL result, including its domain fingerprints and SHA-256 digest, is persisted immediately in the claimed task's assessment_checkpoint using the durable task queue's append-only Issue snapshot chain under the live task/resource fencing proof; a retry restores completed results and fetches only incomplete or failed URLs. Legacy manual execution continues to use the persisted rotation cursor.

document_store_side_effects: Document-store base JSON, manifests, content-addressed shards and temporary staging are written only beneath the isolated RUNNER_TEMP artifact root.
No document-store output is committed, pushed, or written into the repository checkout.

protected_paths.modules/uu.conf: not read or written by this entrypoint
protected_paths.sources/domain_sources.json: not written; assessment does not activate sources

publication_policy.method: After independent artifact verification, scheduler commits only allowlisted persistent history/report paths and their manifest/shard children; it fetches and rebases onto latest main, checks live leases and protected/read-only digests, then performs a non-force push and confirms the remote main SHA.

resource_contract.lock_scope_note: The only shared mutation is the bounded per-URL assessment_checkpoint in GitHub Issue #315, updated through append-only snapshot CAS under the active task lease and both logical resource fences. The three assessment documents are isolated runner-local artifacts; no repository filesystem write or Contents API publication occurs. The exact discovered_sources predecessor digest is read from the verified external artifact root before and after execution.

execution_semantics.idempotency_key: task_id + predecessor workflow_run_id + predecessor artifact_sha256 + URL; completed URL results are immutable within the task checkpoint.
execution_semantics.retry_policy: Resume the same predecessor-bound batch from the durable task-queue checkpoint. Reuse every completed URL result; repeat network reads only for URLs not yet checkpointed or whose prior fetch failed before a result was stored.
execution_semantics.timeout_note: Task input caps each run at 20 URLs, 1 MB per URL and 10 MB aggregate. Each successful URL is checkpointed immediately by a fenced queue CAS; task/resource lease is 480 seconds to cover assessment, independent verification and fenced artifact publication.
success_predicate: Process exits with code 0 and stdout satisfies the reviewed output schema.
Runner-local assessment history, runtime document and report pass schema and shard-integrity verification.
Protected config and all declared read-only repository baselines remain unchanged.
Per-URL progress is stored in the durable task queue with live task and logical resource fencing; no repository artifact publication occurs.
execution_semantics.independent_verifier: scripts/verify_assess_sources_artifacts.py independently checks runner-local runtime/history/report consistency, fingerprints exclusion and non-activation.
execution_semantics.repository_writes: No repository file writes, commits, or GitHub Contents API writes. Per-URL progress is stored only in GitHub Issue #315 durable queue snapshots through append-only CAS under the active task lease and logical/source-assessment-checkpoints plus logical/production-pipeline fences.

dependency_edges.edge_semantics: The Watchdog workflow_run gate downloads the artifact from the exact successful main-branch Shadowrocket Source Discovery (Watchdog) run, validates producer run ID/head SHA and the logical-document digest, then enqueues Assessment idempotently.
dependency_edges.note: The producer commits and uploads the same complete legacy/sharded logical document. Watchdog verifies the exact run proof, downloaded artifact digest, embedded producer metadata and equality with current main; the scheduler independently rechecks the current logical-document digest before claim and the assessor rechecks it before and after execution.
dependency_edges.input_snapshot_validation: The scheduler hashes the complete legacy/sharded discovered_sources document before and after assessment and rejects publication if it changes.
dependency_edges.scheduler_enforcement: The Watchdog downloads the artifact using the workflow_run ID, verifies the proof's workflow name, numeric run ID, full producer commit SHA, allowlisted artifact path and complete logical-document digest, then confirms that the current main document has the same digest and producer metadata. enqueue_source_assessment_task checks the digest again, and scheduler.build_execution_plan rejects changed or missing predecessor content before claim.

permission_boundary.filesystem: Read the verified discovery artifact from its isolated RUNNER_TEMP root and read-only baseline files from main. Write only assessment JSON documents and report under AUTOMATION_ARTIFACT_ROOT inside RUNNER_TEMP. No repository checkout paths are mutated or published; modules/uu.conf and sources/domain_sources.json remain read-only.
permission_boundary.network: HTTPS raw.githubusercontent.com only, repository-bound URL and same-host redirect checks.
permission_boundary.github_api: The assessor may only read and CAS-update the current task's bounded checkpoint in the durable Issue #315 queue using the scheduler-supplied token. It performs no Contents API writes, Git commits, or pushes.
permission_boundary.protected_config: modules/uu.conf is immutable and outside this capability's write set.

blockers: Full transitive writer inventory and cross-workflow runtime trace reconciliation under issue #193 remain a global acceptance gate.

retry_policy.remote_fetches_may_repeat: only for URLs not yet checkpointed or whose previous fetch failed before a result was persisted
